name: ac-investment-oversight-and-ocio
description: Governing an outsourced investment programme: the oversight function and what it must evidence, manager selection and mandate design, investment policy compliance monitoring, performance and risk reporting to a board, the OCIO model and its conflicts, fee and cost oversight, and the written oversight record. It structures the governance of delegated decisions; it never recommends a manager and never predicts returns. Use when asking "OCIO", "outsourced CIO", "investment committee", "mandate design", "how do I monitor my manager", "IPS compliance", "fiduciary oversight", "manager monitoring", "board reporting", "who is responsible for the portfolio". Not for diligencing a manager's operations and terms (ac-manager-and-vehicle-diligence), not for writing the policy itself (ac-investment-policy-statement), not for measuring returns (ac-performance-measurement).
